titulo: Validate ISBN and email when creating books and readers
descricao: Today you can create books with an invalid ISBN and readers with a mistyped email, which breaks searches and return reminders. We want to validate both fields on creation and return a 400 error with a clear message.
criterios: createBook rejects an ISBN that is not a valid ISBN-13 (13 digits, hyphens allowed, correct check digit) with ValidationError
createReader rejects emails without a valid format (something@domain.tld) with ValidationError
POST /books and POST /readers return 400 with the error message
The existing valid cases keep working
There are tests for the valid and invalid cases
